drivers: Three-step chain (percent, fraction, multiplication) with small, clean numbers (3% of 300 = 9)
Fractional number of sales (2.25) is counterintuitive and may cause doubt or rounding errors
Distractors are close in magnitude (±10%) so sloppy estimation does not suffice
120 seconds is ample; no-calculator multiplication 2.25 × 11000 is manageable on paper
